# Social Media & Content Creator Tools (social-tools)
- Telegram Deep-Link & Pre-Filled Message Generator: Create instant t.me links, custom bot launch parameters, pre-filled chat text, and scan-ready QR codes.
- [Instagram Unfollowers & Data Export Delta Tracker](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/social-tools/instagram-unfollower-checker): Private, client-side detection of non-reciprocal accounts and recent unfollower deltas from Meta export ZIPs.

# Text Tools (text-tools)
- [Compare Two Lists & Set Difference Finder](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/text-tools/compare-two-lists): Find differences, intersections, unions, and complements between two text lists.

# Developer Tools (developer-tools)
- CSS Cubic-Bezier Transition Curve Builder: Interactive visual bezier easing generator with motion previews and multi-framework exports (/tools/developer-tools/css-cubic-bezier-generator)
- JSON to TOML & TOML to JSON Dual Converter: /tools/developer-tools/json-to-toml-converter (Fast, browser-native bi-directional JSON & TOML transformer)
- cURL to Fetch & Python Converter (/tools/developer-tools/curl-to-fetch-converter): Browser-native cURL command parser and multi-language HTTP syntax generator.
- CSS Scroll-Snap Carousel & Gallery Playground (/tools/developer-tools/css-scroll-snap-builder): Interactive visual builder for hardware-accelerated CSS scroll-snap sliders and feeds.
